步环节涉及模块验证方式前置依赖
1用户登录获取 TokenM6 authPOST /api/auth/login → 返回 access_token + refresh_tokenMySQL
2设备注册M1 devicePOST /api/device → 200 + device_id → 查库确认Step 1 JWT
3影子创建M1 shadowgRPC Shadow.Create → desired/reported 初始化Step 2
4设备遥测上报→event-dispatcher→KafkaM1mock MQTT publish → dispatcher 日志 "dispatched" → Kafka 有消息Step 2 + EMQX/mock
5告警规则命中→落库→WebSocket+Kafka通知M3 alarmalarm 消费 → 规则命中 → MySQL alarm 表 + WebSocket alarm.created + onepark.alarm.eventStep 4
6调度自动建单→FSM 流转M5 dispatchdispatch 消费 alarm-event → 创建 dispatch_task → 状态 pending→assignedStep 5
7大屏聚合展示M5 dashboardGET /api/dashboard/overview → 4 路数据非 null + WebSocket 实时推送Steps 1-6
